Case Style Converter

Convert any text into camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more.

Type something above to see all styles.

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste your text (variable name, title, phrase).
  2. All six case styles are generated instantly below.
  3. Click the copy button next to the style you need.
  4. Paste it into your code or document.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does it understand my input?

Input is split on spaces, underscores, hyphens and case boundaries (so "myVarName", "my-var-name" and "my var name" all work), then reassembled in the style you pick.

How do I copy a specific style?

Each style shows its own copy button, so you can grab exactly the format you need without retyping.

Is my text uploaded anywhere?

No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.
